correctness.rationale: Theorem 5.1 of Gnedin–Olshanski gives an exact absolutely summable double-index law. Both applications of the q-binomial theorem are proved using a coefficient recurrence; their convergence annulus is q<|z|<1/q. The product at z=-1 has strictly positive convergent factors, and comparison proves strict parameter monotonicity. Equality of generating functions gives the independent-geometric interpretation. The prior He–Müller–Verstraaten identification maps these probabilities to odd/even fixed-point expectation limits. Exact-rational finite diagnostics with certified bounds have been replayed, not confused with infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact marginal pmf is previously known (Gnedin–Olshanski 2011), and the constant-to-parity relationship is previously known (He–Müller–Verstraaten 2022/2023). The addition is the exact bilateral q-binomial summation, geometric factorization, and all-parameter strict inequality and monotonicity that the 2023 source lists as open. Later logical-limit-law literature quotes but does not cover the parity theorem. An unindexed equivalent q-product remains possible, and the relevant thesis chapter was not accessible.
residual_risks: The original 2011 complete displacement law makes the new identity an evaluative consequence of prior work; historical priority hinges on the specific q-binomial resummation and the resulting strict sign and monotonicity, not on a new distribution.
A prior independent publication of the exact q-series product may be indexed under modular/partition terminology rather than Mallows.
The full text of Verstraaten’s 2023 dissertation chapter was not accessible; only its abstract and the overlapping authors’ published full paper were inspected.
Independent historical-priority review is not performed.
